I am an old woman of 70 years, farming my small piece of land here in Mbeya as I have done for many years. For beans, I do not buy the chemical fertilizer — it is too costly, and beans can make their own food from the soil, as my mother taught me. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, and work the plot myself with help from family when they can come. The rains here in the Southern Highlands are good, so I do not need to bring water from anywhere.
